translations.web: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
translations.bsb: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
translations.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
